ratings_why.fun: The growth ramps well: Encore bodies early, Barnstormer and Natrix permanent stats mid, then placement-driven multipliers (Prompter, Old Crest, Hesketh) that I'd happily draft toward.
ratings_why.distinct: Understudy, Notices from any tribe's deaths and Hesketh's mass curtain call are fresh, but the core of Encore, Death Scene and a Death Scene doubler reads like Battlegrounds' Reborn/Deathrattle/Rivendare package.

verdict_why: Every card reads and every tier does its job; what's left is number tuning for the owner, not design fixes.

points.text: Smooth Newt Rehearser has almost nothing worth firing at Tier 2 (only Bit-Part Lizard's +1/+1); a small fallback when there's no Death Scene would keep it from being a vanilla 3/3 on turns 3-5.

Sand Lizard Bill-Poster reads a game-long Notices total that never drops, so its payout per turn keeps climbing and total gain grows quadratically; at 60 Notices it's about 24 stats a turn from a Tier 4.

Dame Natrix in front of the Prompter's Boy is the tribe's best moment: four board-wide +1/+1s a fight, plus shop fires from the Rehearser. Keep it as the build's headline and let the owner set the numbers.
Tier 2 has no buffer, so turns 3-5 rest on Encore bodies alone; that's fine for tempo, but early-game permanent growth is thin next to Hedgerow or Fairies.
Sir Hesketh turning ties and near-losses into a second round is a capstone you'd build the whole comp to reach; it needs the rulebook timing in the risks, not a card change.

standouts.why: A positional multiplier: where you put it and who stands in front is the decision, in fight and in the shop.
A whole second round of fighting as a capstone, and it rewards the attrition wall build.
Little Anguis stepping in and copying the dead lead's Death Scene is a fresh, readable trick with real board planning.

weakest.why: Little to trigger at Tier 2; mostly a 3/3 until Tier 3-4 Death Scenes arrive.
The Natterjack's 1 gold is fine but plain, and it pays most on boards that lose.
The Brothers Berus works only with 1-Health or Encore neighbours; elsewhere it's 4 self-damage for +8 Attack.

flags.note: Notices never get spent, so Bill-Poster's growth per turn rises all game; it may outgrow the Tier 6 payoffs late.
Natrix in front of a golden Prompter's Boy, with Old Crest replays and Rehearser shop fires, stacks board-wide permanent buffs fast; it needs a sim, but it's a high roll worth chasing.
